title: RLPS Pack Index
description: Content-addressed pack versioning + supersession (spec section 7 text-in-effect). Written by `r14n publish` (LOCAL only; hosting an index publicly is counsel-gated). An index entry proves WHAT bytes were published WHEN, never that a pack is lawful. NOT LEGAL ADVICE.

version.description: Monotonic per id. A pack is immutable at a version (spec section 2.5).

sha256.description: Content address of the exact pack bytes.

path.description: Pack location relative to this index file's directory. MUST NOT be absolute (no leading '/') — the index is shareable and absolute paths leak the publisher's local layout.

published_at_unix.description: Unix seconds when the entry was indexed.

supersedes.description: sha256 of the previous latest version for this id; null for the first. Resolvers following a supersession chain MUST land on the highest version whose effective-date envelope covers the query date.

signature.description: Embedded detached signature (rlps-sig/0.1, written by `r14n sign`). Key encodings match reviewer-key.schema.json; the key SHOULD appear in the reviewer-key directory for the decision to escape the advisory-only taint (spec section 6).
